Australia Coach McDonald Addresses Player Availability During IPL

Australia's cricket coach Andrew McDonald is prioritizing player availability, particularly for fast bowlers, during the Indian Premier League (IPL). He stated that managing player well-being is part of Australia's strategy, especially with a busy international schedule ahead, including the World Test Championship final and the Ashes. McDonald indicated that decisions on player participation would involve collaboration with medical and coaching staff.
